verdict.task_title: Host-side inference credential boundary: repository-local implementation tranche
task_criteria: Implement and test a host-only authenticated inference gateway/proxy with node/project/repository-bound revocable expiring service identities and explicit model allowlists. Reject missing, malformed, expired, revoked, wrong-scope and disallowed-model requests before upstream credential resolution. Synthetic sentinels and negative controls must demonstrate no upstream key forwarding or leakage into node installers, argv, errors, logs, artifacts or responses.

Persist trustworthy requested-versus-served model/provider evidence and test that fallback cannot escape the authorized allowlist; do not infer actual served identity from request/config labels. Add reproducible hermetic tests with semantic negative controls, integrate into tests/selftest.sh, and run full selftest and board validation.

Update the governing specs/HARNESS.md and docs/THREAT-MODEL.md (and related references as needed) before code, with implemented vs unimplemented boundaries and runnable check commands. Do not provision a node, read real credentials, change live services or enable the blocked Hermes installer; live node acceptance is explicitly excluded from this local tranche and CF-002 must remain open for original live criterion 5.

Repository-local worker trace and audit resolve CF-002, governing spec, test and observed evidence at the published implementation commit; no claim that a future judge verdict exists. Foreman verifies source/tests and commit before board closure. This tranche verdict is not completion of the full CF-002 board acceptance.
